**Headless Briar! **

This custom skin replaces Briar's base model with a sleek, headless version !

I also removed the belts around her waist for a more stylish look and added dark purple magical tether effects, along with custom loading art.

I poured all my passion for skin creation into this masterpiece; I hope you enjoy it!
